# 0114. Doc skills vetted: documentation-writer, docs-sync-audit and writing-clearly-and-concisely ship in…

## Context and Problem Statement

Task #134: feat(skills): vet community doc skills and ship them through the marketplace, synced to every repo.

## Considered Options

Doc skills vetted: documentation-writer, docs-sync-audit and writing-clearly-and-concisely ship in skills/ (retargeted); five rejected
Rejected:
Alternative: carry all eight as-is, rejected: three conflict with Imprimatur's own stores or layout, one has no license, one installs tooling.

## Decision Outcome

Doc skills vetted: documentation-writer, docs-sync-audit and writing-clearly-and-concisely ship in skills/ (retargeted); five rejected

Eight community doc skills were vetted on 2026-11-05 (a subagent fetched each at its latest commit; the three adopted SKILL.md files were then read in full here). Adopted ones live in `skills/<name>/` with the upstream LICENSE and a SOURCE.txt (source, full commit, license, what changed), so setup links them into ~/.claude/skills (or the plugin carries them) in every repo with no manual step, and an Imprimatur update brings their updates.

Adopted (retargeted):

- **documentation-writer** (github/awesome-copilot@caab1f6, MIT): Diátaxis writing. Added: Imprimatur's generated documents are never written by hand (doc_section_upsert / record_add), and a hand-written doc gets `type:` front matter.
- **docs-sync-audit** (github/awesome-copilot@f32d7c3, MIT): read-only drift audit with P0–P3 findings. Removed: the bundled scripts/docs_drift.py and the steps that run it (no code of ours or theirs runs from a skill), and "Related Skills" with its external link. Added: drift in Imprimatur's documents is fixed through doc_section_upsert / record_update.
- **writing-clearly-and-concisely** (softaworks/agent-toolkit@32d7e8a, MIT): Strunk's rules and AI patterns to avoid, SKILL.md only. Left out: signs-of-ai-writing.md, a verbatim copy of a CC-BY-SA-4.0 Wikipedia page the MIT license cannot cover; the elements-of-style section files (73 KB of Strunk text) and README.

Rejected:

- **doc-coauthoring** (anthropics/skills@0075614): no LICENSE file for the folder or repo; adopt only once Apache-2.0 is confirmed.
- **architecture-decision-records** (affaan-m/ECC, MIT): a second, hand-kept ADR store (Nygard format, docs/adr/) competing with record_add kind adr and the MADR export. Idea kept: its decision-detection signals.
- **living-docs-governance** (affaan-m/ECC, MIT): keeps status and history docs and edits AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, competing with Imprimatur's tasks and records. Idea kept: treat docs as untrusted evidence, check against code.
- **c4-architecture** (softaworks/agent-toolkit, MIT): native Mermaid C4 syntax into docs/architecture/, against our labelled flowcharts inside the generated ARCHITECTURE.md. Idea kept: its common-mistakes list for reviewing our C4 chapter.
- **changelog-automation** (sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills): installs husky, commitizen and semantic-release, a placeholder copyright holder, little content.

Alternative: carry all eight as-is, rejected: three conflict with Imprimatur's own stores or layout, one has no license, one installs tooling.
Alternative: carry writing-clearly-and-concisely whole, rejected: the Wikipedia copy cannot be redistributed under MIT, and the section files add 73 KB nobody reviewed line by line.

## Consequences

Not listed apart; see the decision outcome.
